[P3] 出版者的话

古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”而我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。

现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。

情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养，而幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。

当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。

这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。

让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

[P4] 老师对你说
你也 有一个完美的家
你还记得第一次上幼儿园时哭喊着“我要回家”的情景吗？还记得
某首歌曲中唱到的“我爱我的家”吗？家对每一个人来说都是内心深处永
远的避风港。
而故事中的小刺猬卡米伊为什么竟然想要一个新家呢？走进故事里
才发现，他对于家人的抱怨可真不少：妈妈亲他的次数太多，爸爸没时间
陪他，妹妹太吵了……于是，他离家出走，去寻找心中的完美之家。
紧接着，被收养的小驴、只有妈妈陪伴的小青蛙、与众不同的小猪、
认猫头鹰做妈妈的小燕子、过着群居生活的小狼……卡米伊和他们一一碰
面。他怀疑他们那样的家到底幸不幸福。可是，他发现他们都能安心地接
受自己的家，享受着和家人在一起的幸福。他们的话深深地触动了卡米
伊——原来有爱的家就是完美的！
跟着卡米伊离家的脚步，我们能够发现卡米伊的心路历程：由最初
的困惑，到不断地消解困惑，直至困惑解除后的愉快领悟。在这个过程中，
卡米伊的心灵深处发生了深刻变化，彻底转变了以前对家的态度，获得了
真正的成长。

[P5] 色的背带裤了吗？还有橙色的小被子、橙色的小吉他，以及小青蛙橙色的花眼镜、小牛家橙色的桌子……温暖的橙色带着我们在各种温暖的情景中游走。换句话说，从小卡米伊离家的那一刻，家的温暖色彩就一直伴随着他，从未离去。

另外，这本书的插画拥有明快的色彩、简洁的线条、精巧的画面布局，为我们展现了朴实自然的田园风光，这不正是我们想要的生活吗——平淡宁静，温暖惬意，让人又满足又留恋。

每个有家的人都是幸福的，每个有爱的家都是完美的。不过，这份幸福与完美需要我们用心去体会。所以，还等什么？快给家人一个大大的拥抱吧！

（保定市教科所教研员 刘育红）

两匹骏马正在草原上飞驰。

[P18] 小卡米伊路过一片农场，他看见几只小猪正在泥潭里打滚儿呢。
其中一只小猪名叫安祖，他太小了，还不到六个月。

[P20] 安祖的妈妈对小卡米伊讲道：

[P21] 小卡米伊对这一切感到很新奇，这些家庭的组成是如此与众不同。

[P22] 小卡米伊迎着风在农场里走着，
不过，现在他的肚子已经开始咕咕叫了。
他真想马上吃一棵生菜，或者是一条小虫。

[P23] 这时，他的背后传来了喊声：
“你好呀！你迷路了吗？在这片田野中间干什么呢？”
说话的原来是小牛巴普蒂斯特。善良的小牛邀请小刺猬到家里去吃饭。

[P24] “这是我的爸爸——罗格。”巴普蒂斯特介绍道，“他是我们牛中最强壮的一个。”接着他自豪地说：“这是巴斯蒂安，我的另一个爸爸。巴斯蒂安爸爸做饭做得特别好吃，等会儿你就知道啦！”,

[P25] “你怎么有两个爸爸呢？”小卡米伊惊奇地瞪大了眼睛，
“这怎么可能呢？”
“当然可能了！而且我和你并没有什么不同，我也有两个家长啊！”

小卡米伊吃得饱饱的，然后又上路了。

[P26] 小卡米伊走到了一个小村庄旁边，遇到了一只名叫克雷芒斯的小燕子。
小燕子和一只慈祥的猫头鹰住在一起。
小卡米伊再次感到奇怪极了。

克雷芒斯问猫头鹰：
“巴贝特妈妈，我可以和那只小刺猬一起玩吗？”
“当然可以！我亲爱的宝贝。”

[P28] 在树荫下，小燕子向小卡米伊讲了自己的故事：
“巴贝特并不是我的亲生妈妈，可是她一直负责照顾我，因为我的爸爸妈妈总是飞得很远很远。巴贝特妈妈特别善良，但我有时还是会想妈妈，因为每天晚上睡觉前，妈妈都不在我身边，不能亲亲我。而我的爸爸，我一年都见不到他几次。”

[P30] 小卡米伊陷入了深深的思考中……
他终于发现，每天妈妈给自己的亲吻是那么珍贵！
虽然爸爸没有时间陪自己玩，但至少自己每天都能见到爸爸呀！

[P31] 他高声喊道：
“世界上有完美的家庭吗？”
这时，一头叫维克多的小狼从灌木丛中蹦了出来，回答道：
“我知道！我的家庭就很完美。”

[P32] 维克多解释道：“我们狼生活在群落里，所以除了爸爸和妈妈，我还有三个干爸、七个干妈和三十多个兄弟姐妹。每天晚上睡觉之前我们都打闹好久呢！”,

[P33] 小卡米伊不相信小狼的话，他觉得有一个小妹妹就够了。
不过，他现在有点想念自己的小妹妹了，还有点想念爸爸妈妈。

[P34] 小卡米伊想回家。
幸运的是，回家的路很近。

[P35] 真棒啊！能再次和家人团聚是多么幸福啊！
这次离家旅行很有意义。
现在，小卡米伊终于明白了，世界上并没有十全十美的家庭。
不对！只要一家人相亲相爱，那么我们的家就是完美的。

[P3] Publisher's Note

The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: "Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, and with the right person, that's much harder." What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, and toward the right person.

In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, although possibly intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.

Emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, but ultimately, they rely on learning and cultivation through experience. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create lasting neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.

Currently, the practice of parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and growing with sunlight and rain.

This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks focuses on specific emotional topics for children, illustrating their inner journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a valuable reference for parents during shared reading.

Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey together with this series!

[P4] Teacher says to you
You also have a perfect home
Do you remember crying and shouting “I want to go home” when you first went to kindergarten? Do you remember
the song that goes “I love my home”? Home is a safe haven deep in everyone’s heart.
Why does the little hedgehog Camille in the story suddenly want a new home? When we enter the story,
we find that he has many complaints about his family: his mom kisses him too often, his dad doesn’t have time
to spend with him, his sister is too noisy… So, he runs away from home to find his perfect home.
Next, he meets a donkey adopted by others, a frog with only his mom, a unique pig,
a swallow who takes an owl as his mom, and a wolf living in a group… Camille meets them one by one.
He wonders whether their homes are truly happy. But he discovers that they all accept their homes peacefully,
enjoying the happiness of being with their families. Their words deeply touch Camille—turns out, a home with love is perfect!
Following Camille’s journey away from home, we can see his inner journey: from initial
confusion, to gradually resolving it, until joyful realization. In this process,
Camille’s inner world undergoes deep changes, completely transforming his attitude toward home, and achieving
true growth.
In fact, the author has always used warm colors to portray the warmth of home: notice Camille

[P5] Did you notice the orange overalls? There's also an orange blanket, an orange guitar, the little frog's orange glasses, and the little cow's orange table... The warm orange color takes us through various warm scenes. In other words, from the moment Camille left home, the warm colors of home have always been with him, never leaving.

Moreover, the illustrations in this book feature bright colors, simple lines, and clever composition, presenting us with a simple and natural countryside landscape. Isn't this exactly the life we want—peaceful, quiet, warm, and cozy, making us feel both satisfied and nostalgic?

Everyone who has a home is happy, and every home filled with love is perfect. However, this happiness and perfection need us to experience them with our hearts. So, what are we waiting for? Give your family a big hug!

(Baoding City Educational Research Institute, Researcher Liu Yuhong)

his dad didn't have time to play with him,
and his little sister was always making a fuss.

[P12] Then, Yana carried Camille to a grassland,

[P13] "Are these two horses your parents?" asked little Camille in surprise,

[P14] Goodbye to the little donkey Yana, little Camille continued on his journey.
By the pond, he met a little frog singing "croak croak".
The little frog sang so joyfully, and the melody was so beautiful! Camille wanted to learn this song too.

[P15] "Hello, little frog! This song is so beautiful. Did your family teach it to you? You're so lucky!"

The little frog replied:
"Thank you! My name is Dolina. If you play with me, I'll teach you this song."

[P16] Little Camille carefully jumped onto a lily pad, trying to keep his balance and avoid falling into the water.
Dorina introduced: 
"This is my mom, and we both live in the pond."

[P17] "Where's your dad?" asked little Camille curiously. "He's not here. Who protects you at night?"
"Of course, Mom! Believe me, as long as Mom is here, those toads won't dare to bully us!"

Little Camille and Dorina had a great time playing. Soon after, little hedgehog Camille continued on his way.

[P18] Kamiyi passed by a farm and saw several piglets rolling in the mud.
One of the piglets was named Anzu. He was too young, not even six months old.
Kamiyi greeted Anzu:
"Hello! Why do you look different from the other piglets? Why aren't you pink?",

[P19] Anzu replied, "The reason is very simple! My dad is not a domestic pig, but a wild boar."

[P20] Anzu's mom told little Camille:
"I come from the farm, and Anzu's dad comes from the forest. After little Anzu was born, he quickly adapted to two completely different lifestyles."
Anzu nodded beside her and said:
"Yes! I eat acorns from the forest and corn from the farm. I'm half domestic pig, half wild boar."

[P21] Little Camille found all of this very fascinating; these families were so different from one another.
Nature is truly rich and colorful!

[P22] Little Camille walked through the farm, facing the wind.
But now, his stomach had started to rumble.
He really wanted to eat a leaf of lettuce, or perhaps a little bug right away.

[P23] At this moment, a voice came from behind him:
"Hello! Are you lost? What are you doing in the middle of this field?"
The speaker was the little calf, Baptiste. The kind calf invited the little hedgehog to come to his home for a meal.

[P24] "This is my dad—Rog," Baptiste introduced, "he is the strongest one among our cows." Then he proudly said, "This is Bastian, my other dad. Dad Bastian cooks especially delicious food, you'll see soon!"

[P25] "How can you have two dads?" Little Camille blinked in surprise,
"How is that possible?"
"Of course it's possible! And I'm not so different from you—I have two parents too!"

Little Camille ate until he was full, then continued on his way.

[P26] Camille walked to the edge of a small village and met a little swallow named Clement.
The swallow lived with a kind owl.
Camille felt strange again.

Clement asked the owl:
"Mommy Babette, can I play with that little hedgehog?"
"Of course! My dear baby."

[P28] Under the shade of a tree, the little swallow told her story to little Camille:
"Babette is not my birth mother, but she has always taken care of me, because my parents always fly very far away. Babette is very kind, but sometimes I still miss my mother, because every night before bedtime, my mother isn't by my side, and I can't get a kiss. And my father, I don't see him even a few times a year."

[P30] Little Camille sank into deep thought...
He finally realized how precious his mother's kisses were every day!
Although his father didn't have time to play with him, at least he could see his father every day!

[P1] 本页是绘本《卡米伊想换个新家》的封面，展示了主角刺猬卡米伊的形象，以及作者、译者等信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《卡米伊想换个新家》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者、出版社信息以及主角刺猬卡米伊的形象。
[P3] 本页为绘本《卡米伊想换个新家》的出版者序言，阐述了情绪管理的重要性，强调幼儿时期是培养情绪管理能力的黄金期，并介绍了该系列图画书通过亲子共读帮助孩子管理情绪、解决问题的教育理念。
[P4] 本页是绘本《卡米伊想换个新家》的导读页，通过‘老师对你说’的栏目，介绍了主角卡米伊因对家庭不满而离家出走，寻找完美之家的故事主线，并阐述了他通过与不同家庭的接触，最终领悟到有爱的家就是完美的成长过程。
[P5] 本页为绘本的导读或推荐语，由保定市教科所教研员刘育红撰写，通过分析书中反复出现的橙色元素，强调家的温暖与陪伴，并赞美插画风格，最后呼吁读者用心感受家庭的幸福与完美，给家人一个拥抱。
[P6] 本页介绍了主角卡米伊是一只住在松树林的可爱小刺猬，他深受父母喜爱，画面描绘了他与妈妈在温馨的家中共进早餐的场景。
[P7] 卡米伊在自己的房间里抱怨家庭生活，觉得妈妈亲他太多、爸爸没时间陪他、妹妹总是吵闹，表现出他对当前家庭的不满。
[P8] 卡米伊因爸爸不带他去抓鼻涕虫而大发雷霆，画面中妈妈正在粉刷房子，爸爸背着弓箭准备出门。
[P9] 卡米伊因不满家庭生活而赌气离家出走，画面中他生气地跑开，而妹妹在一旁开心地跳舞。
[P10] 卡米伊在离家出走的路上遇到了一只名叫亚纳的小毛驴，他好奇地询问亚纳是否独自一人以及父母在哪里。
[P11] 小刺猬卡米伊在离家出走的路上遇到小毛驴亚纳，亚纳邀请他回家认识自己的父母，但要求他先停止生气。
[P12] 小毛驴亚纳带着小刺猬卡米伊来到一片草原，指着正在飞驰的两匹骏马，告诉卡米伊那是他的爸爸妈妈。
[P13] 小刺猬卡米伊对小毛驴亚纳的父母是两匹马感到惊讶，亚纳解释自己是被收养的，但每天都很快乐。
[P14] 小刺猬卡米伊告别小毛驴亚纳后继续上路，在池塘边遇到一只正在欢快唱歌的小青蛙，被其歌声吸引，想学会这首歌。
[P15] 小刺猬卡米伊在池塘边遇到正在唱歌的小青蛙多莉娜，称赞她的歌声并询问是否是家人教的，多莉娜表示如果卡米伊陪她玩，就教他唱歌。
[P16] 小刺猬卡米伊小心翼翼地跳上睡莲叶，多莉娜向他介绍自己的妈妈，并说明她们都住在池塘里。
[P17] 小刺猬卡米伊在池塘边与小青蛙多莉娜交谈，询问她父亲的去向，多莉娜表示母亲足以保护她们。两人玩得开心后，卡米伊继续上路。
[P18] 小刺猬卡米伊路过农场，看到几只小猪在泥潭里打滚，他向其中一只名叫安祖的小猪打招呼，并好奇地询问它为何长得和其他小猪不一样、为什么不是粉红色。
[P19] 小刺猬卡米伊在农场遇到小猪安祖，询问它为何与其他小猪不同，安祖解释自己的父亲是野猪，因此自己身上有斑点。
[P20] 小刺猬卡米伊在农场遇到小猪安祖，安祖的妈妈解释了安祖的父亲来自森林，而安祖自己则适应了农场和森林两种生活方式。安祖自豪地表示自己一半是家猪，一半是野猪。
[P21] 小刺猬卡米伊对所见的家庭多样性感到新奇，感叹大自然的丰富多彩。
[P22] 小刺猬卡米伊在农场里走着，肚子饿了，想吃生菜或小虫。
[P23] 小刺猬卡米伊在田野中行走时，被小牛巴普蒂斯特发现并询问是否迷路，小牛邀请他到家里吃饭。
[P24] 小牛巴普蒂斯特向小刺猬卡米伊介绍自己的两个爸爸：罗格和巴斯蒂安，并自豪地表示巴斯蒂安爸爸做饭很好吃。
[P25] 小刺猬卡米伊对小牛巴普蒂斯特有两个爸爸感到惊讶，巴普蒂斯特解释自己也有两个家长，卡米伊吃饱后继续上路。
[P26] 小刺猬卡米伊在村庄旁遇到小燕子克雷芒斯，得知它和一只猫头鹰住在一起，对此感到奇怪。克雷芒斯询问猫头鹰是否可以和卡米伊一起玩，猫头鹰欣然同意。
[P27] 画面展示了一棵大树，树洞里住着一只猫头鹰和一只小燕子，树下有蘑菇和植物，远处是村庄的景象。
[P28] 小燕子克雷芒斯向小刺猬卡米伊讲述了自己的家庭情况：她的亲生父母因迁徙而常年不在身边，由养母巴贝特照顾，她因此会想念亲生父母。
[P29] 画面展示了一只戴着粉色蝴蝶结、穿着粉色靴子的小燕子站在草坡上，周围有蒲公英、雏菊和三叶草等植物，背景是绿色的草地，右下角有二维码和宣传文字。
[P30] 小刺猬卡米伊在思考中意识到妈妈的亲吻很珍贵，虽然爸爸没时间陪他玩，但每天都能见到爸爸。
[P31] 小刺猬卡米伊高声询问世界上是否有完美的家庭，这时一只名叫维克多的小狼从灌木丛中出现，自信地表示自己的家庭就很完美。
[P32] 小狼维克多向卡米伊解释，狼群生活在一个大家庭中，他除了亲生父母，还有多个干爸干妈和兄弟姐妹，每天晚上睡觉前都会一起打闹。
[P33] 小刺猬卡米伊听完小狼维克多关于大家庭的描述后，虽然不相信，但开始想念自己的小妹妹和爸爸妈妈。
[P34] 小刺猬卡米伊想回家，幸运的是回家的路很近。画面中卡米伊在草丛和蘑菇间快乐地奔跑。
[P35] 小刺猬卡米伊与家人团聚，感受到家庭的温暖，并领悟到只要家人相亲相爱，家就是完美的。
[P36] 画面中，小刺猬卡米伊趴在草丛中的蘑菇上，表情略显疲惫或沉思，周围是茂盛的绿草、蒲公英和蘑菇，右下角有二维码及宣传文字，整体氛围宁静自然。
